in_marathi.name: Tithi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tithi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Tithi refers to the lunar day, representing a specific phase of the moon. Each lunar day holds a unique spiritual significance, and Tithi is a name deeply connected to the lunar cycle.

Each lunar day holds a unique spiritual significance, and Tithi is a name deeply connected to the lunar cycle.
